## `BigCommerceAuth`

**GET** `/sso/bigcommerce/auth`

## `GetBigCommerceLoginUrl`

**GET** `/sso/bigcommerce/api/token`

Generate BigCommerce Login URL (GET)

Generates a BigCommerce customer login URL using the provided LoginRadius access token. If the customer does not exist in BigCommerce, it creates one. Returns a login URL that can be used to authenticate the user into BigCommerce.

### Example

```c#

    string accessToken = "<accessToken>"; //Required
    string store = "<store>"; //Required
    Option<string> password = new Option<string>("<password>"); //Optional
    Option<string> returnUrl = new Option<string>("<returnUrl>"); //Optional

    try {
        var response = await client.BigCommerceSSO.GetBigCommerceLoginUrlAsync(accessToken, store, password, returnUrl);
        Console.WriteLine(response);
    } catch (Exception e) {
        var lr = LoginRadiusException.From(0, null, e);
        Console.Error.WriteLine(lr.Description);
    }
}
```

### Parameters

| Name | In | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `access_token` | query | string | yes | Access Token of the User |
| `store` | query | string | yes | BigCommerce store hash identifier |
| `password` | query | string | no | User's password |
| `return_url` | query | string | no | URL to redirect the user to after login |

### Returns

`BigCommerceLoginUrlResponse`
